meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi/pi, oh-my-pi (omp), gajae-code (gjc), OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, Aside browser-agent sessions, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/OMO/Senpi/pi/oh-my-pi/omp/gajae-code/gjc/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider/Aside sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并导出各编码助手的会话记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用多个 AI 编码助手，却总想不起上次怎么写的。
copy.tagline_en: Search and export past conversations from coding assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often lose track of what you did with AI coding tools.

howto.what: 装上后，询问过去的编码会话时，Claude 先扫描本机多种编码助手的日志（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），列出匹配会话摘要（平台、时间、首尾消息、用量），可按子代理、目录、时间过滤，再读取选定会话的详细内容。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找、阅读或导出本地编码助手会话，或问“我昨天做了什么”等记忆回顾问题时触发；提到 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等平台也会触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下昨天 Codex 的会话记录
say.note: 会按平台和时间过滤并列出匹配项。

say.text: 我们之前有没有修过那个 OpenCode 的 bug？
say.note: 会展开多个关键词并行搜索并包含子代理。

say.text: 读取会话 abc123 的完整内容
say.note: 直接显示该会话的转录和子代理列表。

howto.what_en: When asked about past coding sessions, Claude scans local agent logs (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.), lists matches (platform, time, model, messages, usage), filters by subagent/cwd/time, and reads the selected transcript.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to find, read, or export local coding-agent sessions, or on memory-recall questions ('what did I do yesterday'); also when naming platforms like Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.

say_en.text: Find yesterday's Codex sessions for me.
say_en.note: Filters by platform and time, then lists matches.

say_en.text: Did we ever fix that OpenCode bug?
say_en.note: Expands keywords in parallel and includes subagents.

say_en.text: Read the full content of session abc123.
say_en.note: Shows that session's transcript and subagents.
